title: 骨头里为什么有空气
subtitle: 又轻又结实的秘密
character: wearing a teal green t-shirt, light grey shorts and white sneakers, short black hair
style: children's picture book illustration, fine pen and ink lines with light watercolour washes, teal green, pale grey blue and warm cream

pages.zh:
老师递给我
一块恐龙骨头的模子。
那么大一块，
我以为很沉，
一拿——轻得吓一跳。
pages.scene: A head-and-shoulders portrait of the little boy holding a large pale bone model in both hands, only his head and shoulders inside the picture and everything below his chest outside the frame, his face turned straight towards the viewer, both eyes clearly drawn with white, a dark round iris and a small bright highlight, surprised at how light it is.

pages.zh:
把它锯开看看。
里面几乎是空的。
只有薄薄的骨片，
横一道竖一道
撑在当中。

骨头外面
还开着几个洞。
不是摔坏的。
左边一个右边一个，
长得一模一样。
pages.scene: One large pale bone lying alone on a cream background, two deep round openings in its side. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
空的会不会不结实？
一点也不会。
自行车的车架
就是一根空管子，
照样压不弯。

一样粗的两根，
实心的沉，
空心的轻。
可你要把它们掰弯，
费的劲差不多。
pages.scene: Two metal rods of the same thickness lying side by side on a cream background, one cut open at the end showing solid metal and the other cut open showing an empty middle. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
梁龙的脖子里
有十几节这样的骨头，
一节一节都是空的。
要不是空的，
它根本抬不起来。

所以它才能
把脑袋举那么高。
脖子那么长一条，
真要称一称，
也没有多少分量。
pages.scene: One very long-necked dinosaur on a cream background raising its head high above the tree tops. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
这些空腔是谁挖的？
是气挖的。
肺后面连着一串气袋，
气袋一点一点
钻进骨头里去。

今天的鸟
身体里就有这些气袋。
它吸一口气，
那口气要走两趟
才从身上出去。
pages.scene: One pigeon standing in profile on a cream background, its chest puffed out. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
鳄鱼的骨头
是实心的。
鸟的骨头
是空心的。
恐龙的，跟鸟一样。

所以我们才敢说，
这些大家伙
身体里也有气袋。
骨头上那些洞，
就是气袋按出来的。
pages.scene: One huge long-necked dinosaur standing in profile on a cream background, one large pale bone with round openings in its side lying on the ground in front of it. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
我又掂了掂
手里这块骨头。
中间掏空了，
一样结实，
还轻得多。
pages.scene: A head-and-shoulders portrait of the little boy weighing the large pale bone model in one hand, only his head and shoulders inside the picture and everything below his chest outside the frame, his face turned straight towards the viewer, both eyes clearly drawn with white, a dark round iris and a small bright highlight, smiling.
